fieldValues.title: A stance is read relative to its boundary
fieldValues.decision_question: Is a stance fixed, or read relative to where the agent acts?
fieldValues.context: D9 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We work as if a stance is read relative to the boundary it acts in.
fieldValues.rationale: The same agent can take different stances in different groups (proposal section 4).
fieldValues.revisit_when: The same agent's stance needs to be fixed across groups.
